abstract: Ovarian dermoid cysts are made up of solid, cystic and fat tissue. These components give rise to characteristic sonographic features such as a fat-fluid level, dermoid mesh and tip of the iceberg sign. The presence of two or more of these typical features can be used to confidently diagnose a dermoid cyst on ultrasound. This 41-year-old woman with a known cystic lesion on her right ovary which, on ultrasound, demonstrated two of these features, had the diagnosis of a dermoid cyst later confirmed on histopathology. She concurrently had an elevated serum human chorionic gonadotrophin (hCG), an unusual, but not unknown, finding in the presence of a dermoid cyst. The hCG resolved after removal of the ovarian cyst.
abstract_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫は、固形・嚢胞性・脂肪組織から成る。これらの成分により、脂肪-液体レベル、dermoid mesh、tip of the iceberg signといった特徴的な超音波所見が生じる。超音波検査でこれらの典型的所見を2つ以上認めれば、類皮嚢腫と確定的に診断できる。本症例は41歳女性で、右卵巣に嚢胞性病変があり、超音波検査で上記所見のうち2つを認めた。病理組織学的に卵巣類皮嚢腫と確定された。同時に血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が上昇していたが、類皮嚢腫では稀ながら知られた所見である。卵巣嚢腫の摘出後にhCGは正常化した。
